tools.name: rechnio_list_customers
tools.description: List customers of the Rechnio account, optionally searched by company, person name or email. Returns customerNumber, company, contact and address fields. GET /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: rechnio_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Give a company name for a business customer, or a first and last name for a private person. Returns the created customer with its customerNumber. POST /api/v1/customers. If the call fails with a network or timeout error, the record may already exist: list the records first before

tools.name: rechnio_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, newest first, optionally by status (draft, sent, paid, cancelled). Each invoice has invoiceNumber, totals, VAT, dates, customer and line items. GET /api/v1/invoices.

tools.name: rechnio_create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice as a DRAFT. The vendor assigns the next number from the given series. This tool never sends the invoice; the customer sends it in Rechnio. POST /api/v1/invoices. If the call fails with a network or timeout error, the record may already exist: list the records first before you retry

tools.name: rechnio_list_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions, optionally by booking date range, category or account. Each has amount, description, category, bookingDate and account. GET /api/v1/transactions.

tools.name: rechnio_list_receipts
tools.description: List uploaded receipts with their OCR results (date, amount, counterparty, description), optionally only assigned or unassigned ones. GET /api/v1/receipts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rechnio_list_customers, rechnio_create_customer, rechnio_create_invoice · Private data: rechnio_list_customers, rechnio_create_customer, rechnio_create_invoice · Public sink: rechnio_list_customers, rechnio_create_customer, rechnio_create_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rechnio_list_customers, rechnio_create_customer, rechnio_create_invoice · Private data: rechnio_list_customers, rechnio_create_customer, rechnio_create_invoice · Public sink: rechnio_list_customers, rechnio_create_customer, rechnio_create_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
